response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_average FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), qualifying_statuses AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, oa.overall_average FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.overall_average), mean_of_qualifying AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as qualifying_mean FROM qualifying_statuses) SELECT qs.rfistat, qs.avg_modindex, qs.avg_modindex - qs.overall_average as above_average, qs.avg_modindex - mq.qualifying_mean as diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying_statuses qs CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying mq ORDER BY qs.rfistat
